newsitem.title: USA: Credit Acceptance files $300mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Credit Acceptance files $300mln debt shelf.

text.p: Credit Acceptance Corp filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf offering of up to $300 million in debt securities.
Underwriters for the offering may include William Blair & Co, First Chicago Capital Markets Inc and nationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, the company said in the SEC filing.
Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include repaying outstanding debt and financing possible acquisitions.t
